_doc: SSOT shipment list for the dispersed ygg verbs (spec: docs/spec-ygg-verb-dispersal.md).
tier_base: required and PATH-linked on EVERY fleet host - the daemon-independent verbs an agent seat needs anywhere.
tier_gui: ships in the same identical shipment to every host, but only means anything where the yggterm GUI/daemon lives (the GUI hosts: dev/oc locally).
owner_managed: shipped into bin/ygg/ for completeness but NEVER linked or adopted - ygg-memory self-disperses its runners
(sync-fleet scp's them to ~/.local/bin + ~/.yggterm/bin and unlinks symlinks by design) and bootstrap.sh installs ygg-memory-sync.
Two owners on one path is a war the fs spec's one-owner law forbids.
executable: files installed with mode 0755; everything else 0644.
